name: CXO Executives
about: Senior management. Sets the annual strategy, approves major budgets and defines company KPIs.

items.duty: Annual strategy, major budgets, company KPIs

name: ITC IT Committee
about: IT committee. Approves IT projects and major budgets.

name: AIC AI Committee
about: AI management committee. The top oversight body for AI; approves medium- and high-risk AI launches.

items.duty: Approves medium- and high-risk AI launches

name: PMO Project Office
about: Project management office. Sets project management rules, prioritizes across projects and allocates resources.

name: PO Product Owner
about: Product owner. Takes part in prioritizing needs, advises from a strategic view, allocates BA and SA resources and decides key directions. With many projects, a lead PO coordinates several POs.

items.duty: Joins prioritization with a strategic view; allocates BA and SA resources

name: BU Business Unit
about: Business unit. Raises business pain points and needs; after launch it uses the system and turns it into revenue.

items.duty: Raises pain points, turns the system into revenue
Collects feedback, watches results, raises change requests
Scenario and KPIs, business volume, books the benefit
Pilot users try it and report issues
Drives adoption, keeps the knowledge base current

name: BA Business Analyst
about: Business analyst, the contact for business units. Finds and confirms the business unit's needs and hands them to the SA to assess feasibility; helps the business unit complete AI governance documents and functional tests. In AI projects, also agrees the acceptance bar (number of test questions and accuracy) with the business unit up front, and builds the cost-benefit baseline. The right person has close ties with the business units, for example an existing digital PM moving into the role: technical depth can come later, trust has to come first.

items.duty: Turns needs into processes and user stories
Finds and confirms needs for the SA to assess; agrees the acceptance bar with BU; builds the cost-benefit baseline
Compares pilot results with the baseline
Error analysis; actual ÷ baseline = realization rate

name: UX User Experience
about: User experience. In banks this is rarely project staff: it is a specialist team in the digital or customer-experience unit, shared across projects, doing user research, customer 360 analysis, and journey and interface design; projects commission or borrow from it. It often sits in the same digital unit as the PO, but the PO decides and UX supplies the research and design.

items.duty: User research, conversation flow, handoff to a person, usability tests

name: PM Project Manager
about: Project manager. Owns the schedule and scope, coordinates teams and vendors, and runs acceptance. The PM may be the business contact (BA) or the IT contact (IT PM), or a third party in between, such as an innovation or AI team.

items.duty: Schedule, scope, cross-team coordination, vendor contact
Schedule, acceptance, contact for vendors and units
Writes the RFP, manages the vendor's schedule and acceptance
RFP: features plus model, data and compute requirements

name: TPM Technical PM
about: Technical project manager. Coordinates the technical plan across teams, such as the choice of model, platform and architecture, and handles technical dependencies and risks. Unlike the IT PM, the TPM owns the technical plan and represents no department; in banks the role is often filled by an architect, a senior SA, the AI team or the vendor's technical lead.

items.duty: Coordinates model, platform and architecture decisions
Coordinates build, platform and deployment decisions

name: IT PM IT Project Manager
about: IT project manager, the IT department's contact for the project. Plans IT's schedule and budget, brings in applications, infrastructure, databases and security, and handles IT procurement and the change process (CAB). Unlike the TPM, who owns the technical plan, the IT PM owns IT's resources and schedule; on a small project one person may do both.

items.duty: Represents IT; coordinates architecture, databases and environments
Represents IT; assesses in-house systems, environments and resources
Coordinates integration, environments and the release schedule

name: SA Systems Analyst
about: Systems analyst, working at the application layer. Assesses feasibility and development resources for the scope and assigns the technical team; designs the application architecture and specs (functions, data flows, APIs, integration with core systems) and writes the technical side of the AI governance documents. The infrastructure layer (servers, network, GPUs, environments) belongs to Infra; the SA states the performance, capacity and cloud or on-prem requirements and confirms security and infrastructure compliance.

items.duty: Assesses feasibility and resources, cloud or on-prem; prototype
Assigns the technical team; system spec, APIs, data flow

name: EA Enterprise Architect
about: Enterprise architecture. Checks that a new system meets the bank's architecture and technology standards.

items.duty: Checks the bank's architecture and technology standards

name: DBA Database Admin
about: Database administrator. Designs and maintains databases.

name: DE Data Engineer
about: Data engineer. Prepares the data AI needs: sources, cleaning and labeling.

name: DS Data Scientist
about: Data scientist. Designs features, runs model experiments and analyzes results.

name: MLE ML Engineer
about: Machine learning engineer. Tunes the model: prompts, RAG, model choice and fine-tuning.

items.duty: Re-tests after each model update, written into the contract

name: SDE Software Engineer
about: Software engineer. Builds features to the spec and writes unit tests; in banks, often a vendor's engineer.

items.duty: Front-end and back-end code, unit tests
Builds features and unit tests; often outsourced

name: FDE Forward-Deployed Eng
about: Forward-deployed engineer. Works inside the business unit, wires AI into the real workflow and keeps adjusting it on site after launch.

items.duty: Embedded with the business, wires AI into the workflow and adjusts on site
Collects issues on site, adjusts flow and prompts
Embedded at the bank, wires AI into the workflow

name: AP Application Owner
about: Application owner. Owns the bank's core systems and APIs; new systems connect to them, and this unit takes over maintenance after launch.

items.duty: Connects to core systems, interface specs

name: Infra Infrastructure
about: Infrastructure. Provides servers, network, production and test environments; for AI projects, GPU compute as well.

items.duty: Servers, network, production and test environments
GPUs, network, production and test environments
GPUs or a hybrid cloud environment

name: QA Testing
about: Testing team. Writes test cases and runs system and integration tests. In AI projects, also measures answer accuracy and consistency with an evaluation set.

items.duty: Test cases, system and integration tests
Integration tests; rerun the eval set on every change
Acceptance with the bank's own test questions

name: MLOps Model Operations
about: Model operations. Manages model and prompt versions, and monitors answer quality, model drift and cost.

name: Ops Operations
about: Operations team. Deploys systems to production and handles monitoring, backups and incidents.

name: CAB Change Advisory Board
about: Change advisory board. Approves changes to production and their timing.

items.duty: Approves production changes, models and prompts included

name: SD Service Desk
about: Service desk. Takes user issues and passes them to the team responsible.

items.duty: Takes user issues and passes them to AP

name: EU End User
about: End user. The customer who actually uses the system.

items.duty: Uses the system, gives feedback, generates revenue

name: OP Frontline Staff
about: Frontline staff. Employees who work with AI, such as underwriters and call-center agents, and confirm its output.

items.duty: Underwriters and agents work with AI and confirm each case

name: ISO Information Security
about: Information security. Owns data classification, access control and attack protection, from design to launch.

items.duty: Data classification, what may go to the cloud
Red team: attacks, data leaks, guardrails

name: CCO Compliance
about: Compliance. Confirms the project follows regulations and sets the red lines.

items.duty: Contracts, data protection and outsourcing rules

name: CRO Risk
about: Risk management. Assesses and rates project risk, and keeps monitoring it after launch.

name: MRM Model Risk Management
about: Model risk management. Part of the second line; validates models independently of the team that built them: whether they can be used, and their limits.

name: WG AI Working Group
about: AI working group. Keeps the inventory of the bank's AI, confirms risk ratings and does the first review of pre-launch checks.

items.duty: Inventories AI, rates risk, first review

name: IA Internal Audit
about: Internal audit. The third line; independently checks that the process followed the rules.

name: PR Procurement
about: Procurement. Runs bids, negotiation and contracts.

items.duty: RFP, bids, contract; for AI, a PoC first
PoC first, then bids and contract

name: CSP Cloud Provider
about: Cloud service provider. Provides cloud models and compute.

name: MA Vendor Maintenance
about: Vendor maintenance. Fixes issues during the warranty period and provides maintenance under contract.
